description: Source code for the WorkerWatcher class in Apache Spark, responsible for monitoring a worker process and terminating JVM if connection is severed.

classes.name: WorkerWatcher
classes.description: A class that connects to a Spark worker process and terminates the JVM if the connection is lost, providing fate sharing between the worker and its child processes.

methods.name: exitNonZero
methods.description: Terminates the JVM with System.exit(-1) unless in testing mode, in which case it sets a flag.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Handles incoming messages; logs a warning for unexpected messages.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Logs successful connection to the worker.

methods.name: onDisconnected
methods.description: Logs disconnection and triggers JVM shutdown.

methods.name: onNetworkError
methods.description: Logs network errors and triggers JVM shutdown.
